environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway. The instance has a public IP and security group allowing inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service. An attacker can send SIGTERM to trigger the race condition (e.g., via a separate vulnerability or container escape), or simply time requests to /admin/dump during a deployment rolling restart when SIGTERM is sent by the orchestrator.

config.network: Public subnet with IGW, security group ingress 0.0.0.0/0:8080
config.deployment: systemd service with rolling restart via CodeDeploy
config.access: Direct internet access to application port
